title: Understand company goals, customers and trends
summary: Strategy starts from the facts: what the company is trying to achieve, what customers need and what is changing around you. Gather these before forming a view.

beginner: Read the company's goals and the last year of results.
Collect what you know about customers: research, feedback and usage data.
List the trends that could change your market, such as new technology or regulation.
Talk to a few people in sales, support and finance.
Summarise what you found on two pages.
intermediate: Map the value chain from customer need to the parts that deliver it.
Mark which parts are changing fast and which are commodities.
Separate facts from assumptions, and note where evidence is thin.
experienced: Scan across the portfolio, not just one product.
Test your view against outside perspectives, such as analysts or advisers.
Identify the few forces most likely to change the business.

toolExamples.miro: Draw the value chain and trends on one board.
toolExamples.google-docs: Keep the two-page summary with links to the evidence.
